ios.desc:
FRAME 37 is a digital disposable film camera. No preview. No delete. No retakes.
You shoot blind, wait for the roll to develop, and only see your shots once the
film is ready.

Just like real film used to be.

SHOOT BLIND
Point and press. You don't see the frame until it's developed — exactly like a
real disposable camera. No preview screen, no second chances. One frame, one shot.
36 frames per roll.

WAIT FOR THE DEVELOP
Finished a roll? Send it to the darkroom. Your film "develops" on a timer, and the
album only unlocks once it's done. The wait is part of the fun — load a new film
while you wait.

PICK A FILM WITH CHARACTER
Every film gives its own color and mood — warm tones, grain, mono, unexpected
shades. Classic emulsions and limited drops. Choose yours and load it.

NO NOISE
• No preview — you don't see the frame until it's developed
• No delete — you keep it exactly as you shot it
• No retakes — only honest frames
• 36 frames per roll

WHY IT WORKS
Modern cameras kill the moment: a hundred takes, endless scrolling, perfect but
empty photos. FRAME 37 brings back the feeling of real film — you live the moment
instead of watching it through a screen. Less control, more life.

Load a film. Shoot blind. Wait. See what you got.

FRAME 37
point & wait.
